title: Reports
subtitle: Your donor reports: you pick the sources, and Claude drafts each section only from them, with citations.

list.title: Your reports
list.count: {count, plural, =0 {No reports} one {# report} other {# reports}}
list.emptyBody: Pick a template and a period and the sections are set up for you. Once you add sources, Claude drafts each section from them.
list.late: {count, plural, one {# day late} other {# days late}}
list.left: {count, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}

form.title: Title
form.audienceHint: Claude adjusts the tone to them.
form.newHint: The template brings its sections, guidance and word limits.
form.duplicateHint: The sections, guidance and word limits are copied; the text and sources start empty.

template.title: Read a donor template
template.hint: Pick the donor's report template. Claude lists its sections, what each one asks for and the word limits; you correct the list and keep it.
template.checkHint: The sections Claude found. Check them, correct them, then save.
template.notConnected: Reading a template needs the AI to be connected.
template.uploadFirst: If the file isn't listed, upload it to <link>Files</link> first.
template.name: Template name
template.heading: Section heading
template.guidancePlaceholder: What the donor asks for in this section (optional)
template.saveAsHint: This report's sections, guidance and word limits become a template; the text is not included.

page.backToDraftDone: The report is a draft again
page.progress: {done} of {total} sections written · {words, plural, one {# word} other {# words}}
page.startBody: Claude writes this report only from the files, meetings, notes and indicators you pick. If the report has a period, the suggest button brings up what belongs to it.
page.visualsEmpty: No charts or one-pagers are linked to this report.

sources.title: {count, plural, =0 {Sources} other {Sources · #}}
sources.addedMany: {count, plural, one {# source added} other {# sources added}}
sources.only: Claude reads only these for this report; nothing else is used.
sources.suggestRecent: Suggest from the last three months
sources.suggestHint: What belongs to {period}. Untick anything you don't want.
sources.suggestHintNoPeriod: Meetings, decisions, notes and files from the last three months. Untick anything you don't want.
sources.suggestNone: Nothing new to suggest. You can pick sources yourself with “Add”.

reasons.values: Indicators with values for this period
reasons.dates: By date: meetings, decisions, notes and files

sources.empty: No sources yet. Add files, meetings, notes or indicators; Claude writes only from them.
sources.aiOff: Closed to AI: Claude does not read this
sources.offNote: {count, plural, one {# source is closed to AI and is not used in drafts.} other {# sources are closed to AI and are not used in drafts.}}

section.deleteBody: “{heading}” and its text will be deleted. This can't be undone.
section.editHint: Click outside or press ⌘/Ctrl + Enter when you're done; Esc drops the changes. Numbers like [1] point to the sources.
section.empty: Still empty. Claude can draft it from the sources you picked, or you can write it.
section.emptyNoSources: Still empty. Add sources first for Claude to draft it, or write it yourself.
section.drafting: {count, plural, one {Claude is writing from # source…} other {Claude is writing from # sources…}}
section.draftNoCitations: This draft cites no sources; check it carefully before you use it.
section.draftCheck: Compare it with the sources before you use it.
section.instructionRewrite: How should Claude change the text?
section.instructionWrite: What should Claude keep in mind?
section.instructionPlaceholder: e.g. Lead with the Q3 field visits and keep the challenges short
section.settingsHint: Claude follows the guidance and the word limit when drafting.
section.heading: Heading
section.guidanceHint: The explanation from the donor template; Claude writes to it.

quick.shorterNote: Shorten it by about a third, keeping the same facts.
quick.formalNote: Write it in a more formal, objective donor-report tone.
quick.numbersNote: Bring forward the figures from the sources and the progress against targets.
quick.fitLimitNote: Bring the text under {limit} words; keep the most important results.

check.title: Number check
check.summary: {total, plural, one {# figure} other {# figures}}: {mismatch} differ, {match} match, {missing} not in the IPTT
check.none: No figures to check in the text
check.stale: The text changed after the check.
check.showOthers: {count, plural, one {Show the other figure} other {Show the other # figures}}

chart.empty: Nothing to show yet. Pick indicators or enter values in the IPTT.

visuals.title: Charts and one-pagers
visuals.empty: No visuals yet. Charts and one-pagers are drawn live from the IPTT and the workplan, and download as PNGs for Word.
visuals.newChartHint: Choose what to show, or describe it to Claude. The numbers always come from the IPTT and the workplan.
visuals.newOnePagerHint: A period's headline figures, a chart and a few points, on one A4 page.
visuals.name: Name

sourceHints.indicator_periods: One or more indicators, period by period, with targets
sourceHints.indicator_partners: One indicator's value at each partner
sourceHints.indicator_progress: Each indicator as a share of its life-of-project target

visuals.describePlaceholder: e.g. Households reached by partner over the last four quarters
visuals.onePagerAbout: Once it's created you choose the figures, the chart and the points; Claude can also suggest them from the period.

indicatorHints.indicator_periods: Up to {max} indicators in the same unit.
indicatorHints.indicator_progress: Leave empty to show every indicator with data; up to {max}.

visuals.noIndicators: No numeric indicators yet. You can add them in <link>Indicators</link>.
visuals.cumulativeHint: Each period includes the ones before it.
visuals.subtitle: Subtitle
visuals.language: Language of the words in the picture
visuals.languageHint: The legend, axis words and source line use this language, and numbers and dates are written its way.

notes.text_indicator: Text indicators can't go on a chart, so they were left out.
notes.no_indicators: Nothing to show; pick an indicator that has values.
notes.no_periods: The chosen periods have no values or targets.
notes.too_many_partners: There are more than three partners; the rest are grouped under “Other”.
notes.mixed_units: Indicators in different units can't share a chart; only those in the first indicator's unit are kept.

visuals.nothingToExport: There's nothing in the picture to download yet.

onepager.fill: Let Claude fill it from the period
onepager.fillHint: The heading, figures and points are suggested from the IPTT; the numbers themselves are always drawn from the IPTT.
onepager.heading: Heading
onepager.periodHint: “This period” figures come from this period.
onepager.label: Label
onepager.labelPlaceholder: A short label instead of the indicator name
onepager.noCharts: Create a chart first; then you can pick it here.
onepager.footerHint: Leave empty to show the project name.
onepager.emptyHint: Add a figure, a chart or a point and the page builds up here.
onepager.pageNote: A4, one page. The PNG you download is exactly this picture.
